limitations.description: The Release-4 base remains external and SHA-pinned. FMDL-4A publishes a non-mutating additive overlay and does not claim to have repacked or rewritten the base ZIP.
FMDL-4A creates routing and evidence envelopes. Company research objects and graduation decisions belong to FMDL-4B.
Candidate, simulation and real-account states remain unchanged in FMDL-4A.
